title: EdulabsAI — A Connected AI Teaching Pilot

scenes.narration: A useful school AI pilot should reduce repeated work without reducing teacher control.
EdulabsAI connects curriculum-aware planning, editable resources, live delivery, evidence and the next teaching decision.
Teachers can work across broad K–12 curricula and subjects, with optional source grounding for exact local material.
Class and group communication is teacher administered, moderated and paused during focused assessments when required.
Paper recognition is de-identified and review-first, so automation never silently becomes a grade.
Family communication is consent first, source backed and teacher approved before delivery.
The result is one inspectable lesson record with clear human checkpoints, instead of scattered tools and copied context.
Book an EdulabsAI school pilot at edulabsai dot com.
